dataset_name: GLOBALISE - Places in the Dutch East India Company Archives
proposed_scope: Single .xlsx gazetteer file (place names, coordinates, feature/habitation classification)
access_gate: ACCESS_REQUEST_REQUIRED (confirmed, CC-BY-4.0 license but gated download)
recommended_action_this_turn: DO_NOT_DOWNLOAD -- this turn is metadata-only and not authorized to submit an access request
recommended_action_future_turn: Researcher-gated future turn may authorize (a) submitting the access request, and (b) once granted, downloading only the .xlsx (skip the 2 PDF documentation/envelope files unless needed) for a read-only cross-check against this project's own fort-name spelling variants (reference_ejaan_sillida_salido).
